name: Hyperliquid token details (HYPE supply)

terms.note: POST {"type":"tokenDetails","tokenId":"0x0d01dc56dcaaca66ad901c959b4011ec"}. Only maxSupply, totalSupply, circulatingSupply, nonCirculatingUserBalances and futureEmissions are used; prices and the genesis list are ignored. The node uses this result locally and does not broadcast it.

limitNote: Hyperliquid documents 1200 weight per minute per IP for all info requests; tokenDetails weighs 20. Stated in weight so the shared api.hyperliquid.xyz bucket keeps the exchange records’ rate. The reply is about 5.2 MB because it embeds the genesis balance list. One read per hour.

name: Hyperliquid spot meta and asset contexts

terms.note: POST {"type":"spotMetaAndAssetCtxs"}. Only the HYPE circulating and total supply fields are used; prices are ignored. The node uses this result locally and does not broadcast it.

limitNote: Hyperliquid documents 1200 weight per minute per IP for all info requests; spotMetaAndAssetCtxs weighs 20. Stated in weight like the exchange records, because the shared api.hyperliquid.xyz bucket takes the lowest rate of everything using the host (60 here held both tickers to one request per 40 s). One read per hour.
